title: News strip rotates every few seconds
what_happened: The strip under the hero (Bulletin, Featured Story...) changes by itself every few seconds while I'm trying to read and click, so the page kept shifting under me.
expected: A strip that stays put, or that stops rotating when I hover or reach it.

title: Trip photos don't load on "What Our Trips Look Like"
what_happened: All three trip cards (Community Clinic, Community Build Week, Sports Exchange) show a broken image with alt text instead of a photo. This is the one place I most wanted to see real groups on the ground.
expected: Real photos of groups doing each kind of trip.

title: No named person for partnerships or group trips
what_happened: The contact page gives a general email, phone, a form with a 'Partnership Opportunities' topic and a 24 to 48 hour reply promise, which is good. But nowhere along Get Involved, Trips or Contact is a person named who handles group trips or partnerships.
expected: A name and role, such as a partnerships or trips coordinator, so I know who will read my message.

repro.step: tap "Travel Experience the transformative power of cross-cultural connection through our Cultural Connections program. Join a"
tap "What can we help you with?"

title: Menu dropdowns stay open and cover the page
what_happened: After I clicked Get Involved and Where We Work, their dropdowns stayed open on the next page and while I scrolled, covering the page title and content cards. The contact form's topic list also stayed open after I scrolled.
expected: Menus close once the page loads or when I move away.

repro.step: tap "Travel Experience the transformative power of cross-cultural connection through our Cultural Connections program. Join a"
tap "What can we help you with?"

title: Group trips and partnership route are clear and honest
what_happened: Get Involved, then Travel, then the Trips page said plainly that academic, corporate, faith and common-interest groups can partner for a customized trip. It showed three trip types with countries, led to a contact form with a 'Partnership Opportunities' topic and a 24 to 48 hour reply promise, and the Nicaragua page names real communities. None of this sat behind a sales call.
expected: Same; this is what I hoped for.

repro.step: tap "Travel Experience the transformative power of cross-cultural connection through our Cultural Connections program. Join a"
tap "What can we help you with?"
